name: Freyalise
description: Freyalise is a half-elven planeswalker of Dominaria, worshiped as a goddess by elves, who cast the World Spell that ended the Ice Age.

summary.text: Freyalise is a half-elven planeswalker of Dominaria, worshiped as a goddess by elves, who cast the World Spell that ended the Ice Age.

citations.text: "Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

"Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She helped the elves survive the Ice Age and was deified by them, fought Szat on Azoria where he blinded her, and charged Jaeuhl Carthalion to expel Szat.

citations.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She cast the World Spell in 2934 AR to break the Shard and end the Ice Age, beginning the Thaw.

citations.text: "World Spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"The Thaw". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She returned as one of Urza's Nine Titans, set a bomb against Yawgmoth, and took Eladamri and his elves to Keld, later erecting the Martyrs' Tomb.

citations.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: In the Time Spiral era she gave her spark and her life to close the Skyshroud rift, and the forest died with her.

citations.text: "Rift", section "Skyshroud rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Future Sight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: She is dead, having sacrificed herself and Skyshroud to seal the rift over Keld.

citations.text: "Freyalise", section "Time Spiral". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: until Freyalise cast her World Spell to end it

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Zilgeth's death Freyalise becomes leader of Clan Ruby.

citation.text: Essence Filter (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah helps Freyalise through her ascension.

timeline.summary: Freyalise helps the elves survive the Ice Age and is deified by them.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise is tricked by Faralyn, who wanted the energy of a planeswalker's death to escape the Shard.

timeline.summary: Freyalise fights Szat on Azoria, destroys the islands of the plane, and is blinded by Szat.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise arms and instructs Jaeuhl Carthalion to expel Szat.

citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
